title: Free PDF tools — merge, split, rotate and reorder without uploading
description: Merge PDFs, split them, delete pages, rotate pages and put them in a different order, then save. Your file is opened in your browser and never uploaded to anyone, which is the difference that matters when the PDF is a contract, a payslip or a medical letter. No account, no watermark, no daily limit. A free alternative to iLovePDF, Smallpdf and Adobe Acrobat online.
